content:
I can read and understand dozens of languages! Here are some examples:

- **Major world languages:** English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, Turkish, Vietnamese, Thai, Swahili, etc.
- **Other notable languages:** Dutch, Greek, Hebrew, Polish, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian, Finnish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Slovak, Croatian, Serbian, Bulgarian, Malay, Indonesian, Filipino, Persian (Farsi), Ukrainian, etc.
- **Less widely spoken languages:** Basque, Catalan, Galician, Welsh, Irish, Icelandic, Latvian, Lithuanian, Estonian, Slovene, etc.

I can also attempt to read many more languages, though the quality of my responses or translations may be better with more widely used or well-documented languages.

If you tell me which language you want to use, I’ll do my best to help!
